function_calls.arguments: {"reason": "The text does not assume its conclusion in its premises. \"Les experts sont unanimes, donc c'est vrai\" is an appeal-to-authority style inference, not a circular one: the premise (expert unanimity) is independent of the conclusion (truth). The second sentence, \"si vous n'\u00eates pas expert, votre avis ne compte pas,\" is a dismissive claim, not a reworded premise. None of the P\u00e9tition de principe children (Argument circulaire, Cercle cart\u00e9sien, Question pi\u00e8ge, Conclusion excessive, analogical begging, Soutien infond\u00e9, Pente glissante, Avoir toujours raison) describes this structure, so this branch yields no match."}
